name: AutisMind AI
description: Intelligent healthcare system designed to assist in developmental monitoring and behavioral trend prediction.
challenge: Providing clinical-grade behavioral predictions under strict privacy constraints and lightweight memory profiles.
solution: Built offline-capable inference workflows using compiled light models running locally inside sandbox worker threads.

narrative.problem: Traditional behavioral tools are subjective and require complex, expensive setups. AI tools require remote APIs that present user privacy risks.
narrative.architecture: Configured a sandboxed evaluation runtime that loads quantized prediction matrices locally, keeping patient information fully on the client device.
narrative.decisions: Selected local inference over server-side models to meet HIPAA-grade privacy constraints and eliminate remote network points of failure.
narrative.metrics: 100% offline predictability with sub-50ms execution delay.

name: TeraSight / PrithviQ
description: AI-powered environmental intelligence platform turning satellite and environmental imagery into actionable analytics.
challenge: Processing high-resolution spatial imagery and delivering sub-second visual updates on client maps without browser bottlenecks.
solution: Decoupled rendering from data ingestion, using custom multi-threaded Python workers for image tiling and rendering tiles on demand.

narrative.problem: Satellite imagery datasets are massive and non-standardized. Statically rendering these on web maps causes high latency, blocking client execution threads.
narrative.architecture: Implemented a tile-on-demand strategy. A Python (FastAPI) ingestion pipeline splits and normalizes spatial formats, feeding custom R3F map overlays that lazy-load coordinates based on viewport bounds.
narrative.decisions: Chose FastAPI for CPU-bound image operations due to its async speed, and Next.js App Router to fetch metadata frames cleanly.
narrative.metrics: Achieved sub-200ms render speeds for custom map layers.

name: CampuSwap
description: Student-focused marketplace providing peer-to-peer textbook and resource transactions with integrated search routing.
challenge: Designing a reliable real-time transaction negotiation framework with low database connection overhead under high peak traffic.
solution: Implemented cached socket mappings in-memory and unified API requests with optimistic updates on the client UI.

narrative.problem: University marketplaces suffer from high transaction drops due to slow message delivery and stale item listings.
narrative.architecture: Engineered a real-time negotiation engine using WebSocket clusters alongside optimistic client states to give instant UI feedback.
narrative.decisions: Chose Document-oriented schemas for highly flexible item specifications and set up strict index filters to optimize queries.
narrative.metrics: Reduced message latency to <15ms with 99.9% delivery rate.
